nodes.label: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
nodes.author: Jiyan He, Guang Liang, Hao Liu, et al.

nodes.label: ZGCM-1: 7B Foundation Model
nodes.rationale: Fully open 7.39B dense model trained with extreme efficiency, coupling deliberate internal thinking with active external tool use across 256K context.

nodes.label: Hybrid Sliding-Window and Global Attention
nodes.rationale: Interleaves gated sliding-window attention (27 layers, 128-token window) with global attention (5 layers) at 5:1 ratio; achieves 3.94× throughput speedup at 256K context.

nodes.label: FP8 Pre-Training with Muon Optimizer
nodes.rationale: System-algorithm co-design combining Muon optimizer, hybrid FP8 precision, and TWEO outlier regularization; achieves ~4.2× pre-training time-to-loss speedup.

nodes.label: MDP Mid-Training with Context Scaling
nodes.rationale: Reformulates interaction traces into Markov Decision Process state-action transitions; progressively scales context across 600B tokens (16K→64K→256K).

nodes.label: AI-Native R&D Workflow
nodes.rationale: Researcher-directed agent swarms autonomously manage cluster operations, data curation, and diagnostic evaluation across full model development lifecycle.

nodes.label: Efficiency Scaling: 4.2× Time-to-Loss Improvement
nodes.rationale: ZGCM-1 achieves ~4.2× pre-training time-to-loss speedup through hybrid attention, FP8 precision, and Muon optimizer co-design.

nodes.label: Long-Context Generalization via Progressive Scaling
nodes.rationale: Progressive context scaling (16K→64K→256K) with MDP supervision enables efficient long-context training without catastrophic loss spikes.

nodes.label: Agentic Co-Training Dynamics
nodes.rationale: Mixed think/no-think fine-tuning on execution-verified trajectories balances deep reasoning with direct-response efficiency for tool-augmented agency.

nodes.label: ZGCM-1 Foundation Model
nodes.rationale: 7.39B dense foundation model optimized for mathematical reasoning and agentic search across 256K context; core artifact of the paper

nodes.label: Hybrid Sliding-Window Attention (SWA)
nodes.rationale: 5:1 ratio of gated sliding-window to global attention; delivers 3.94× throughput speedup and 6.4× KV-cache reduction at 256K

nodes.label: Muon Optimizer
nodes.rationale: Matrix parameter optimizer with 1.8× step-to-loss efficiency over AdamW; contributes to ~4.2× pretraining speedup

nodes.label: TWEO Activation Regularizer
nodes.rationale: Suppresses intermediate activation outliers; enables FP8 training stability when combined with delayed scaling

nodes.label: FP8 Mixed-Precision Training
nodes.rationale: Transformer Engine hybrid FP8 (E4M3 forward, E5M2 backward) with delayed scaling; contributes 1.5× throughput gain

nodes.label: General Pre-Training Stage
nodes.rationale: Two-stage pre-training: Stage 1 (0.99T tokens, 16K context) with curriculum ordering; Stage 2 (3.20T tokens, 16K context) with balanced mixture

nodes.label: Curriculum Pre-Training
nodes.rationale: Lexical complexity ordering for general-language documents; improves coding BPB 1.99→0.81 and math BPB 0.97→0.94 at 10B tokens

nodes.label: Mid-Training Stage
nodes.rationale: Capability-oriented continued pre-training with progressive context expansion: 16K (180B tokens), 64K (240B tokens), 256K (180.51B tokens)

nodes.label: MDP State-Action Modeling in Mid-Training
nodes.rationale: Reformulates agentic traces as Markov decision process-style state-conditioned next-action prediction; provides denser per-step supervision

nodes.label: Supervised Fine-Tuning Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Multi-stage data curation combining rule-based filtering and model-based quality scoring; 4.92M examples organized into general and agentic data

nodes.label: Unified Think/No-Think Supervision
nodes.rationale: Interweaves explicit reasoning chains with direct responses; enables dynamic toggling between deliberation and efficient zero-shot responses

nodes.label: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)
nodes.rationale: RL algorithm for mixed reinforcement learning stage; constructs relative advantages within response groups for policy optimization

nodes.label: Data Mixture Composition
nodes.rationale: Balanced across web, code, mathematics, academic/OCR, reasoning, and instruction data; adjusted across pre-training and mid-training stages

nodes.label: Atomic Capability Evaluation (ACE)
nodes.rationale: Fine-grained diagnostic benchmark with 2,503 probes across 183 atomic capabilities in 18 categories; enables rapid iteration during development

nodes.label: AI-Native R&D Workflow
nodes.rationale: Agents participate across data engineering, architecture design, learning algorithms, experimentation, infrastructure, evaluation, and deployment

nodes.label: AI4AI Autonomy Levels
nodes.rationale: Five-level rubric (L1-L5) assessing AI autonomy in R&D tasks; experimentation and deployment reach L4, architecture and learning algorithm design at L2

nodes.label: Finding 1: Curriculum Pre-training
nodes.rationale: Lexical complexity is cheap corpus-scale ordering signal for general-language text but poor difficulty proxy for code and mathematics

nodes.label: Finding 2: TWEO Enables FP8 Pretraining
nodes.rationale: Suppressing intermediate activation outliers crucial for FP8 training stability; combined with delayed scaling prevents numerical divergence

nodes.label: Finding 3: Pretraining Efficiency Gain
nodes.rationale: Co-design of hybrid SWA (1.4×), FP8 (1.5×), Muon (1.8×), and Pre-LN (1.1×) yields ~4.2× speedup in 16K pretraining time-to-loss

nodes.label: Finding 4: Data Quality Trumps Volume
nodes.rationale: Pruning ~50% of SFT candidates improved six-benchmark mean from 67.78 to 68.83; gains concentrated in reasoning (BBH +10.10)

nodes.label: Finding 5: Long-CoT Trade-offs
nodes.rationale: Long chain-of-thought supervision exhibits non-monotonic utility; oversaturation degrades instruction-following; dynamic calibration mitigates

nodes.label: Finding 6: General Data Necessity for Agents
nodes.rationale: Agent-only fine-tuning degrades interaction fidelity; co-training with general instruction data provides indispensable grounding

nodes.label: Finding 7: Long Agentic Mid-Training Bypasses Ultra-Long SFT
nodes.rationale: Long-context foundation from Mid-Training allows robust reasoning at 256K using only moderate-length SFT data

nodes.label: Binary Function Search Benchmark
nodes.rationale: Evaluates agent capability to locate target functions in stripped ELF binaries; ZGCM-1 achieves 62% on 50-task subset

nodes.label: Web-Environment Deep Research Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Thinking-enabled ReAct policy with up to 64 search-and-read steps; ZGCM-1 achieves 63.09% on WebWalkerQA
